title: Paperclip
description:
A daily trading puzzle inspired by Kyle MacDonald, who in 2005 traded a red paperclip up, one swap at a time, until he had a house.

Every day you start with the paperclip and a market of traders who each do one swap. Some want two things before they'll deal with you, some hand you two things back, and there's always a longer route that also works, so the first one you find usually isn't the best. Mondays are 5 trades, weekends are 7, and three stars means you found the shortest route without touching undo. Every trade also plays a note one step up a scale, so a good run sounds like you walking up to the prize.

Free every day, no account needed. Playable with VoiceOver, NVDA or JAWS.

pricing.note: A one-time US$1.99 unlock adds unlimited practice, Expert markets and the archive
